name: Amnesiac
ability: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.
setup: The Storyteller secretly designs the Amnesiac's ability before the game.
wakes: Whenever the hidden ability requires (orders 32 first night and 47 other nights are placeholders; the real slot depends on the ability).
interaction: At night acts as the hidden ability dictates. Each day privately guesses the ability; the Storyteller answers Cold, Warm, Hot or Bingo.
drunk_or_poisoned: The hidden ability malfunctions (no effect or false info). The wiki does not say whether the daily accuracy answer may also be false.

rulings.text: Feedback: Cold (very wrong), Warm (on the right track), Hot (very close), Bingo (exact). A correct guess in different words counts.
The ability should be guessable over time and may be slightly stronger than a normal Townsfolk.
Night order numbers are from the bra1n townsquare roles.json; 0 there is recorded as null.

test_scenarios.name: hot-guess
test_scenarios.setup: Seat 1 Amnesiac (hidden: each night point at two players, learn if either is a Minion), seat 2 Imp, seat 3 Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: points at seats 2 and 3, gets a nod. Day: guesses 'I learn if both are Minions'.

test_scenarios.name: bingo
test_scenarios.setup: Amnesiac with hidden ability 'learn how many living neighbours are Townsfolk'.
test_scenarios.actions: Day: guesses exactly that in different words.

test_scenarios.name: cold
test_scenarios.actions: Day: guesses 'I protect a player at night'.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned-amnesiac
test_scenarios.setup: Amnesiac (two-player Minion check) poisoned by the Poisoner.
test_scenarios.actions: Night: points at the Poisoner and a Townsfolk.
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller may give a false head shake.
